cities.name: Green Bay
cities.local_context: Green Bay is the largest city in NE Wisconsin and Geo Carpentry's home market (HQ: 735 E Walnut St Suite 3). Lakefront and historic homes (some 100+ years) drive ongoing renovation demand. Lambeau Field area sees seasonal home upgrades. Winters (avg snowfall 51in) demand carpentry built for thermal expansion + moisture.
cities.demographic_signal: Median household income $48K. Mix of fixer-uppers + custom builds. Heavy DIY culture (Packers fans love their man caves).
cities.permits_authority: City of Green Bay Inspection Department + Brown County permits for additions/structural

cities.name: Appleton
cities.local_context: Appleton is the largest city in the Fox Cities region, 30 minutes south of Green Bay. Higher median income than Green Bay ($58K). Strong corporate presence (Thrivent, Schreiber Foods HQ) drives executive home renovations. Historic Victorian district downtown requires careful restoration carpentry.
cities.demographic_signal: Skews higher-end remodels ($15K+). Kitchen + bathroom renovations dominate. Custom built-ins demand.

cities.name: Oshkosh
cities.local_context: Oshkosh sits on Lake Winnebago, 45 min south of Green Bay. EAA AirVenture brings 600K visitors annually + Airbnb-driven renovation demand. UW-Oshkosh student rental market needs landlord-friendly turnkey reno. Lakefront cabins and year-round homes require winterization expertise.
cities.demographic_signal: Mix of young families + retirees + university rentals. Median income $52K. Deck-building strong (lake access).

cities.name: De Pere
cities.local_context: De Pere is Green Bay's affluent southern suburb, separated by the Fox River. St. Norbert College + higher median income ($72K) drive premium renovations. Historic riverfront homes (some 1880s) need restoration. Newer subdivisions south of town demand kitchen/bath upgrades within 5-10 years.
cities.demographic_signal: Higher-end work: kitchen $15-30K, bath $8-15K, custom decks $5-12K. Quality > price for this market.
cities.permits_authority: De Pere Building Department + Brown County

cities.name: Howard
cities.local_context: Howard is a fast-growing suburb NW of Green Bay (was 11K in 2000, now 20K). Heavy new construction + first-time renovations on 1990s-2010s builds. Family demographic (median age 38). Glendale schools attract young families with disposable income for kitchen/bath upgrades.
cities.demographic_signal: Young families: kitchen open-concept conversions, basement finishes, deck additions. Median income $68K.
cities.permits_authority: Village of Howard Inspection Department + Brown County

page_content_brief_template.first_150_chars_rule: First 150 chars must answer 'Do you do {service} in {city}?' directly. AI Overview citation primer.

required_sections_in_order.heading_pattern: What We Do — {Service} Services for {City} Homeowners

must_include: Licensed + insured (no specific numbers — privacy rule)
Local: 735 E Walnut St Green Bay

required_sections_in_order.heading_pattern: Our {Service} Process: From Quote to Final Walkthrough
About {City} & Why Our Work Lasts Here
required_sections_in_order.note: This is the THIN-CONTENT antidote — make each page genuinely different per city

trust_signals_throughout: Licensed Wisconsin general contractor (no license number — privacy)
4.0+ Google reviews (avoid stating exact count unless current)
Local team: 735 E Walnut St Suite 3, Green Bay WI 54301
anti_thin_content_rules: EACH city section must reference 2+ city-specific elements (neighborhood, county, demographic, climate, permit authority)
NEVER write '{service} in {city}' more than 8x per page (avoid keyword stuffing)
Vary anchor text in internal links — no 2 pages should have identical phrasing for same target URL
Cite at least 1 specific local detail per page (avg snowfall, named neighborhood, county permit office)

link_targets: 2 links → adjacent city-service pages (e.g. from green-bay → appleton + de-pere)
1 link → different service same city (e.g. from kitchen/green-bay → bathroom/green-bay)
internal_linking_strategy.anchor_text_variation_rule: Same target URL gets max 2 different anchor texts across all 30 pages. NO exact-match anchor abuse.

address: '735 E Walnut St Suite 3, Green Bay, WI 54301' (same NAP for all pages)

aggregateRating: from existing reviews (4 reviews, 5.0 stars per fix5 deployed 2026-05-27)
